name: Shinsen Renki
source:
The Shinsengumi is an organization that exists to protect the district of EDO, and you are their commander! You'll start a new life with strong, unique, and attractive team members. Which division do you want to join?

[From [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/42084675644/shinsen-renki-release-dates-iphone]English Otome Games[/url]]
translation:
新选组是一个负责保护江户地区的组织，而你就是他们的指挥官！你将和强大、独特又迷人的队员们一起开始新的生活。你想加入哪个分队？
